notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Important:
- Physics has been redesigned, now it should work more correctly.
- Added training (disabled in settings).
- The method of chopping firewood has been changed. The axe is now a used item.
- Added a new "tracker" item. It can be purchased in the store.
- Added a small "mushroom retraction" if you collect them in the basket.
- Firewood for the stove now needs 8.

Corrections:
- Redesigned button icons.
- Money for the order is now credited correctly.
- Orders do not disappear after loading.
- Fixed a bug that made it impossible to take a pot.
- The display of items in the inventory has been improved.
The rest:
- The volume of footsteps can now be adjusted separately.
- Updated animations.
- Item names have been updated.
- Improved animation and logic while simultaneously examining the mushroom and the diary.
- Other minor improvements and changes.

Important:
- Changed the spawn of fly agarics, death caps, and slippery jacks
- Added a new assortment for purchase in the store
- Reduced the spawn rate of all mushrooms
- Added the “Polish mushroom”
- Added a Help section in the settings
- Added a field-of-view (FOV) option
- Added a mouse-sensitivity option

Other:
- Added footstep and jump sounds
- Added a box for jars
- House ambient sound is now muffled instead of completely muted
- The game version is now displayed in the menu
- Fixed an error when selling a jar of mushrooms
- Slightly reduced walk, run, and sprint speeds
- The trader now has collision
- Various minor tweaks

notes.title: Update Demo Hotfix v1.0.3
notes.notes:
Changes and Fixes:

Added journal tooltips.

Fixed an issue where the language would automatically reset to English.

Added a loading screen.

Fixed the basket animation after viewing the journal, as well as the appearance of indicators on mushrooms.

It's no longer possible to grab mushrooms through the lid of a sealed jar.

Changed the player's starting position.

Other minor fixes and improvements.

We’re also working on larger updates and improvements to the demo — stay tuned for the next release!

Thank you for your support and feedback!
You can leave your thoughts on our \[Discord server] or \[Telegram chat].
